data.name: Cluckopia
data.detailed_description:
🐓 ONE ROOSTER. ONE PROMISE. A WORLD OF ISLANDS TO UNRAVEL.

You are Tuti, a brave-hearted rooster whose sister vanished without a trace. The search leads you to a forgotten archipelago where legendary roosters hid their powers long ago — and where every island holds a clue, a danger, and a possible new home.

📖 A story to hold on to

Follow your sister's trail through an adventure full of quests, charming characters, and ancient secrets. Between one clue and the next, a whole village of hens is counting on you.

🏡 Build, farm, cook

Raise houses block by block, decorate rooms, grow crops, and discover recipes that restore energy and win hearts. Your home base evolves along with you.

💛 Friendships worth gold

Lucinda, Magali, and the other hens have their own routines, wishes, and stories. Earn their trust through conversations and petting — every friendship opens new doors and brings the village to life.

🦋 A world that breathes

Butterflies land on your shoulder, hens chat about the rain, clouds drift across the sky, and every friend reacts in her own way when you come close. It's the little details that make the islands feel truly alive.

⚔️ Level up like a true RPG

Gain levels, split your energy between HP and powers, and master 6 proficiencies — Farming, Mining, Gathering, Cooking, Combat, and Forging. The more you do, the better you get.

⚡ Legendary powers

Every legendary rooster you find teaches you a new talent: energy pulse, lightning dash, and much more. Combine powers to match your fighting style and face increasingly dangerous creatures.

👑 Face the giants

Not everything in the archipelago is peaceful: creatures have come to life and serve powerful bosses — the Scarecrow King is only the first. Study every enemy in the RoosterWiki, ready your powers, and step into the arena.

📸 Photo Mode

Pause the world and become a photographer: frame, zoom, and capture your favorite moments. Build an album of your archipelago memories and share the best ones with friends.

🥚 Challenges & Golden Eggs

Many challenges await — harvest, build, cook, photograph, defeat giants — and every one you claim earns a Golden Egg. Many are secret: discover them by playing. The greatest feats unlock Steam achievements, and your egg collection is never lost.

🌅 Explore at your own pace

Day and night, rain and shine, islands to discover and mysteries to solve. Dozens of intertwined systems—building, combat, village life, weather, and honor—designed to suit whatever time you have to play. Play for 15 minutes or the whole afternoon—adventure awaits.

🌍 Available in 10 languages · 🎮 Full controller and keyboard/mouse support · 🏆 Steam Achievements

❤️ Made with love by a solo developer, in memory of a very special white rooster named Tuti.

🐣 Add to your wishlist and follow Tuti until the launch!

data.short_description: A charming little rooster in a voxel world, searching for his missing sister! Build the home of your dreams: farm, cook, decorate your village and win hearts at your own pace — and when danger shows up, awaken legendary superpowers.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Thai

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires GPU with Vulkan support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
